title: soc2-evidence-daily-scratchpad
content:
2026-03-02 - daily scratchpad / quick wins and blockers

Morning notes:
- Quick sync w/ Priya (10:00) to confirm remaining evidence for CC6 and CC7. Need final signed contracts from AcmeSec (vendor) before EOD Tuesday.
- Asha will follow up on encryption key rotation proof for Private deployments (ticket SEC-512). Ask: do we accept vendor-provided rotation logs or require customer-managed KMS export?

Top priorities (this week):
1) SOC2 evidence collection: remaining artifacts
   - Vendor: AcmeSec (SaaS logging) -> action: request SOC2 report + AOC + SSO SAML config screenshots. Status: asked vendor 2026-02-28, pinged again 2026-03-01.
   - Vendor: CloudInfraCo (infra) -> got SOC2 report but missing scoping doc. Follow-up assigned to Priya.
   - Internal: Key rotation proof for private deployments -> need rotation schedule + sample audit log (Asha).
   - Internal: Onboarding checklist for Dedicated (reserved capacity) -> draft needs final review (me).

2) Vendor reviews (quick triage)
   - AcmeSec: medium risk; dependency on third-party logging for audit trails. Questions: retention policy, access controls, subprocessor list. Add to vendor track spreadsheet (link in Confluence).
   - DataMasker Inc: low risk; already approved by platform-engineering; verify one-off dev environment exception.

3) Policy TODOs
   - Update encryption-at-rest policy to clarify customer-managed KMS expectations (owner: me). Draft to product by 2026-03-05.
   - Add procedure for prefix/KV cache persistence (serving-runtime) under CC9 evidence (notes: may need dev signoff).

Notes from yesterday's review:
- Evidence packet for CC5 looks good except missing access review logs for 2025-12 and 2026-01. Action: ask SRE to export IAM access reports (ticket: infra-847).
- Found mismatch in control owner mapping in Confluence (Control matrix v2). TODO: reconcile with product-ops and update mapping table.

Quick checklist (today):
- [x] Morning sync with Priya
- [ ] Follow up with AcmeSec for AOC (send template + deadline)
- [ ] Draft email to SRE for access logs (infra-847)
- [ ] 1:1 with Asha to confirm KMS artifact format
- [ ] Update policy doc header and send to product for review

Questions / open items:
- Do we accept screenshots + metadata (timestamp, URL) as evidence for SSO configuration, or require full export? (ask compliance manager)
- How to store vendor SOC2 reports securely in Google Drive while limiting access? Suggest: restricted folder under shared_drives/security-and-compliance with DRM tags. Need to confirm with InfoSec.

Random notes / fragments:
- Slack threads: #sec-soc2 (link: slack convo id: C03X9J2) - reference for AcmeSec back-and-forth.
- Possible shortcut: create a template checklist for each vendor with required artifacts (SOC2 report, AOC, subprocessor list, encryption details, SSO config, retention). Save as vendor-evidence-template.md in shared docs.

End of day plan:
- Prioritize vendor AOC and SRE access logs.
- Block 2h in afternoon to clean up control mapping and push updates to Confluence.

Notes-to-self:
- Keep evidence filenames consistent: <vendor>-<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf (helps index/search).
- If vendor delays > 5 business days, escalate to account owner (cc: AM).

Links to follow up:
- Confluence control matrix: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/Control+Matrix
- Linear ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/SEC-274-vendor-risk-scan
- Infra ticket for logs: infra-847

-- Jordan
